subject: Business Research Methods
notes: Research methodology core. No numerical questions apply; extra objective and case items included.

questions.text: The systematic investigation to discover new facts and solve problems is
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.explanation: Research is a systematic enquiry to establish facts and solve problems.

questions.text: Research that aims to solve a specific practical problem is
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.explanation: Applied research addresses immediate practical problems.

questions.text: Research conducted to expand fundamental knowledge is called
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.explanation: Basic research seeks knowledge for its own sake without immediate use.

questions.text: Research always begins with defining the problem
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.explanation: Defining the problem clearly is the first and most important step.

questions.text: List the steps in the research process
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.correctAnswer: Defining the problem review of literature formulating hypotheses research design data collection analysis and reporting.
questions.explanation: These steps guide the research from problem to report.

questions.text: Explain the types of research
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.correctAnswer: Research may be basic or applied exploratory descriptive or causal and quantitative or qualitative depending on purpose and approach.
questions.explanation: Classify research by purpose design and data type.

questions.text: A tentative answer to a research question that is tested is a
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: A hypothesis is a testable statement of expected relationship.

questions.text: The review of existing studies on a topic is the
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: The literature review surveys prior work to frame the study.

questions.text: A null hypothesis states that there is no relationship between variables
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: The null hypothesis asserts no effect or relationship.

questions.text: State the characteristics of a good research problem
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: A good problem is clear significant researchable and feasible within time and resources.
questions.explanation: These qualities make the problem worth studying and solvable.

questions.text: Explain the importance of a literature review
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: A literature review avoids duplication identifies gaps refines the problem and provides a theoretical foundation and context for the study.
questions.explanation: Cover gap identification and theoretical grounding.

questions.text: The overall plan for conducting the research is the
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Research design is the blueprint for data collection and analysis.

questions.text: The process of selecting a subset of a population for study is
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Sampling selects a representative group from the population.

questions.text: In simple random sampling every member of the population has an equal chance of selection
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Random sampling gives every unit an equal and independent chance.

questions.text: List the types of sampling methods
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Probability methods like random stratified and cluster sampling and non probability methods like convenience and judgement sampling.
questions.explanation: Sampling methods divide into probability and non probability.

questions.text: Explain the essentials of a good research design
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: A good design is flexible appropriate efficient and economical and minimises bias and error while answering the research question reliably.
questions.explanation: Cover flexibility efficiency and bias reduction.

questions.text: Data collected directly from respondents for the study is
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Primary data is gathered first hand for the current research.

questions.text: The tool consisting of a set of questions for respondents is a
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: A questionnaire is a structured set of questions for data collection.

questions.text: Observation is a method of collecting data by watching behaviour
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Observation records behaviour directly without questioning respondents.

questions.text: Distinguish between primary and secondary data
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Primary data is original and collected for the study while secondary data already exists from earlier sources.
questions.explanation: The difference lies in who collects and the original purpose.

questions.text: Explain the methods of collecting primary data
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Primary data is collected by observation interview questionnaire and schedule each with its own strengths and limitations for different situations.
questions.explanation: Describe each method and when it is appropriate.

questions.text: The process of examining data to draw conclusions is
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Data analysis transforms raw data into meaningful findings.

questions.text: The test used to determine whether sample results support the hypothesis is a
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Significance tests assess whether results could occur by chance.

questions.text: A type one error occurs when a true null hypothesis is rejected
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Type one error rejects a null hypothesis that is actually true.

questions.text: Define hypothesis testing
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Hypothesis testing is a statistical procedure to decide whether sample evidence supports or rejects a null hypothesis.
questions.explanation: It accepts or rejects the null hypothesis at a significance level.

questions.text: Explain the types of errors in hypothesis testing
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Type one error rejects a true null hypothesis while type two error accepts a false null hypothesis. Lowering one tends to raise the other for a fixed sample.
questions.explanation: Define both errors and their trade off.

questions.text: The final document that presents the research findings is the
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: The research report communicates the findings and conclusions.

questions.text: Presenting another persons work as ones own is called
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Plagiarism is using others work without acknowledgement.

questions.text: Research ethics require obtaining informed consent from participants
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Informed consent protects participants and is an ethical requirement.

questions.text: List the characteristics of a good research report
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Clarity accuracy objectivity proper structure and appropriate presentation of data.
questions.explanation: These qualities make the report useful and credible.

questions.text: Explain the importance of research ethics
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Research ethics protects participants ensures honesty and integrity builds public trust and safeguards the credibility of findings.
questions.explanation: Cover participant protection and research integrity.

questions.text: Assertion: Sampling is preferred to a census for large populations. Reason: Sampling saves time and cost while giving reliable results
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion
Both are true but reason does not explain assertion
Assertion is true but reason is false
Assertion is false but reason is true
questions.explanation: Sampling gives reliable results faster and cheaper than studying everyone.

questions.text: Match the tool to its use
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: A questionnaire is self administered while interviews ask and observation watches.

questions.text: Research that seeks to discover cause and effect relationships is
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.explanation: Causal research tests cause and effect relationships between variables.

questions.text: The entire group of interest to the researcher is the
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: The population is the total group from which a sample is drawn.

questions.text: Explain the significance of research in business decisions
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.correctAnswer: Research reduces uncertainty provides evidence for decisions identifies opportunities and problems and improves the quality and success of business choices.
questions.explanation: Cover evidence based decision making and risk reduction.

questions.text: A variable that the researcher manipulates is an independent variable
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: The independent variable is manipulated to observe its effect on the dependent variable.

questions.text: Explain the advantages and limitations of questionnaires
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Questionnaires are cheap cover wide areas and standardise responses but suffer from low response rates and the risk of misunderstanding questions.
questions.explanation: Balance reach and cost against response and clarity problems.

questions.text: Read the case: A company wants to know why its sales fell but has no clear idea of the cause. Recommend a type of research to begin with and justify it
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.correctAnswer: The company should start with exploratory research using interviews and focus groups to understand the situation before designing a formal descriptive or causal study.
questions.explanation: Exploratory research clarifies an unclear problem first.

questions.text: Read the case: A researcher finds a strong association between advertising and sales in a sample. Explain what hypothesis testing would tell him and the risk of error
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Hypothesis testing determines whether the association is statistically significant or could be due to chance with the risk of type one error if the finding is actually random.
questions.explanation: Link significance testing to the risk of false conclusions.

questions.text: The research design that studies the same subjects over time is
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Longitudinal research follows the same subjects over an extended period.

questions.text: Explain the contents of a research report
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: A report contains the title page introduction review of literature methodology findings conclusions and recommendations followed by references and appendices.
questions.explanation: Describe the standard structure of a research report.

questions.text: The selection of a sample based on the researchers judgement is
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Judgement sampling is a non probability method using expert choice.

questions.text: Explain the criteria for evaluating a research report
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: A report is evaluated on clarity of objectives soundness of method adequacy of data validity of analysis and the logic of conclusions and recommendations.
questions.explanation: Cover each criterion for assessing quality.

questions.text: Secondary data is generally cheaper and faster to obtain than primary data
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: Secondary data already exists so it is cheaper and quicker to collect.

questions.text: Explain the importance of sampling in research
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Sampling makes research feasible for large populations saving time and cost and can be more accurate than a census through careful control of data collection.
questions.explanation: Cover feasibility cost and accuracy advantages.

questions.text: List the sources of secondary data
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Books journals government publications company records and the internet.
questions.explanation: These published and internal sources provide secondary data.

questions.text: Explain the steps in hypothesis testing
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.correctAnswer: Hypothesis testing proceeds from stating the null and alternative hypotheses through choosing a significance level and test statistic to comparing and deciding to accept or reject.
questions.explanation: Trace the formal steps of a significance test.

questions.text: A pilot study is a small scale trial run of the research instrument
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.explanation: A pilot study tests the questionnaire on a small sample before the main study.

questions.text: Explain the difference between exploratory and descriptive research
questions.subject: Business Research Methods
questions.topic: Meaning types and process of research
questions.correctAnswer: Exploratory research investigates an unclear problem to generate insights while descriptive research describes characteristics of a population or phenomenon precisely.
questions.explanation: Contrast the purpose and flexibility of the two designs.
